examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default label without the required indicator. The label points at its input with `for`.

examples.name: Required
examples.summary: Required label — appends the inline `* (Required)` indicator. The label points at its input with `for`.

examples.name: Hinted
examples.summary: Hinted label — `hint` appends a Hint glyph after the text. Hover or focus it to read the explanation. The label points at its input with `for`.
